test.title: Test notification
test.body: If you can see this, this device can receive notifications from this server.

identitySkipped.title: Still looking for a release of {title}
identitySkipped.body: Some releases share a title with another movie and could not be identified, so they were skipped. The subscription will keep searching; no action is needed.

stuck.title: The download of {title} {units} has stalled
stuck.body: The download has stalled and no alternative release of the same quality was found. Searching again in about {hours} hours; you can also select another release in the subscription.

subtitles.title: No subtitled release of {title} {units} yet
subtitles.body: After {hours} hours, no release with {acceptable} subtitles is available. There are {count} releases in the original {language}. Keep waiting or download an original release from the subscription.

moreEpisodes.title: Season {season} of {title} may have {count} episodes
moreEpisodes.body: TMDB lists only {count} episodes, but {source, select, site {later episodes have appeared on a tracker} other {Douban lists more episodes}}. Confirm the episode count in the subscription to continue following later episodes.

device.title: A new device signed in to your account
device.body: Your account on {server} just signed in on {device} ({kind}){hasSource, select, yes {, from {ip}} other {}}. If this was not you, sign it out under Account > Devices.

update.inApp: Update under Settings > Updates and maintenance.
update.docker: This version requires updating the Docker image. See Settings > Updates and maintenance for instructions.
update.title: MovieClaw {version} is available

tips.prewarmTitle: Precut clips for smoother trailers and browsing
tips.prewarmBody: People are already browsing clips or watching trailers on your TV. Enable precut clips under Settings > Playback for faster starts and smoother playback.

preferences.importedDescription: When a movie or show you subscribed to or downloaded is organized into your library
preferences.startedDescription: When a release is found for your subscription and sent to a downloader
preferences.identitySkippedDescription: Notify once when a release with the same title cannot be identified; no action is needed
preferences.subtitlesDescription: When a smart subscription reaches its deadline without suitable subtitles; original releases are not downloaded automatically
preferences.upgradedDescription: When your subscribed content is replaced by a better release
preferences.completedDescription: When all episodes you subscribed to are in the library; no duplicate alert if the episode card already announced completion
preferences.stuckDescription: When a subscribed download stalls and no alternative release is found; once per download
preferences.moreEpisodesDescription: When a tracker or Douban lists more episodes than TMDB; confirm the count to continue following
preferences.libraryArrivedDescription: When a library you follow receives new movies or episodes, regardless of who downloaded them
preferences.deviceSignedInDescription: When an app, player, command-line client or transcoder signs in to your account
preferences.alertRaisedDescription: Downloader, tracker or import problems that need an administrator
preferences.alertResolvedDescription: Replace the original notification with a quiet resolution notice when the problem disappears
preferences.updateDescription: Notify once for each new MovieClaw version
preferences.tipDescription: Notify once when a setting could improve your experience, such as precutting clips for browsing and TV trailers
preferences.agentFinishedDescription: When the AI assistant finishes or fails in the app or browser, even if you switched apps; IM conversations already receive their replies in chat

alert.resolvedBody: The problem has resolved itself. No action is needed.
alert.pendingTitle: {count, plural, one {# issue needs attention} other {# issues need attention}}
alert.subscriptionCompleteBody: Everything in the subscription is in the library; nothing left to wait for.

cards.partialBody: {episodes} ready to watch; {count, plural, one {# episode is} other {# episodes are}} still downloading
cards.waitingBody: {episodes} still downloading. We’ll let you know when they’re ready
cards.mute: {kind, select, movie {Mute notifications for this movie} other {Mute notifications for this series}}
cards.newTitle: {kind, select, video {New video} tv {New series} other {New movie}}: {title}
cards.startedTitle: {upgrade, select, yes {Downloading an upgrade for {title}} other {Downloading {title}}}
cards.startedBody: {hasDetail, select, yes {{detail}. } other {}}{batch, select, yes {We’ll let you know when the first episodes are ready} other {We’ll let you know when it’s ready}}
cards.seriesCompleteTitle: {title}: the complete series is in your library
cards.seriesCompleteBody: {seasons, plural, =1 {All {episodes} episodes are ready} other {All {seasons} seasons ({episodes} episodes) are ready}}. {action}
cards.seasonCompleteTitle: {title}: all of {season} is in your library
cards.seasonCompleteBody: {count, plural, one {# episode is ready} other {All # episodes are ready}}. {action}
cards.missingBody: We haven’t found releases for {episodes} yet. We’ll let you know when we do
cards.availableBody: {episodes} ready to watch. Tap to start at {episode}
cards.behindBody: You haven’t watched {episodes} yet. Tap to continue with {episode}
cards.caughtUpBody: You watched through {episode}. Pick up where you left off

summary.libraryTitle: {count, plural, one {# new {kind, select, video {video} other {title}}} other {# new {kind, select, video {videos} other {titles}}}} in "{library}"
summary.downloadTitle: {count, plural, one {Your downloaded {kind, select, video {video is} other {title is}}} other {Your # downloaded {kind, select, video {videos are} other {titles are}}}} in your library

pluginStartup.title: "{title}" failed to start
pluginStartup.body: {reason}. Other features are still available. Restart the app after fixing the issue. See Settings → Plugins for details.

safeMode.title: Plugin safe mode is active
safeMode.body: {reason}. Skipped plugins: {plugins}. After investigating, leave safe mode in Settings → Plugins to reload them immediately.

callbackFailure.title: Callback verification keeps failing for plugin {plugin}
callbackFailure.body: Callback endpoint {endpoint} failed verification {count} times in a row. The token or key configured on the platform may differ from the plugin’s, or someone may be probing this address. If needed, replace the callback address on the plugin page.

siteVerification.title: Tracker "{site}" failed verification
siteVerification.body: Credentials for tracker "{site}" failed verification: {reason}. This tracker is excluded from search and downloads. Update its credentials in Settings → Trackers.

downloaderPaths.title: MovieClaw cannot see the download directory for "{name}"
downloaderPaths.body: The connection works, but {count, plural, one {# mapped local path is} other {# mapped local paths are}} unavailable. Completed downloads cannot be imported. {detail}

siteSyncStopped.title: Sync is suspended for tracker "{site}"
siteSyncStopped.body: Tracker "{site}": {reason}. This tracker is excluded from search and downloads. Check its credentials and verify again in Settings → Trackers.

channelStale.title: The {channel} account has expired; IM notifications cannot be sent
channelStale.body: Login credentials for {channel} have expired. Link the account again to restore notifications and AI conversations.

recycleHeld.title: Automatic deletion paused: too many expired cloud files
recycleHeld.body: {count, plural, one {# expired file is} other {# expired files are}} stored in the cloud (about {size, number, 0.0} GB), exceeding the automatic deletion limit. Select Clean up now in the recycle bin to delete them, or restore them to keep them.

driveFailure.title: {status, select, auth_expired {Sign in again to cloud drive "{name}"} other {The API for cloud drive "{name}" has changed}}

landingGroup.title: MovieClaw cannot see directory {path} for downloader "{name}"
landingGroup.body: {detail}. {count, plural, one {# completed download is} other {# completed downloads are}} stuck in this directory ({size, number, 0.0} GB), affecting {subscriptions, plural, one {# subscription} other {# subscriptions}}. Automatic release replacement is paused for these subscriptions until the directory is accessible; downloading more releases would repeat the same content.

landingFailed.title: "{name}" finished downloading but cannot be imported
landingFailed.body: {healthy, select, yes {"{name}" finished downloading. MovieClaw can see {path}, but "{root}" is missing. The files may have been moved or renamed in downloader "{downloader}". Check the task’s save location, or delete the task and download again.} other {"{name}" finished downloading, but MovieClaw cannot find it at {path}. {detail}}}

ingestFailed.title: {count, plural, one {# entry failed} other {# entries failed}} to import from watch folder {path}
ingestFailed.body: {names}{overflow, select, yes { and other entries (# {count} total)} other {}} failed to process. MovieClaw will retry with backoff. See the list in Settings → Watch folders for details.

upgradePaused.title: Upgrades paused after repeated specification mismatches
upgradePaused.body: "{title}" {unit}: {count} consecutive releases did not match their claimed specifications. Upgrades are paused for 30 days. Check candidate quality or adjust the rule set in subscription details.

specMismatch.title: Imported file specifications differ from the release claims

removeSourceFailed.title: Some download tasks for "{title}" could not be deleted
removeSourceFailed.body: The library files were deleted. {detail}. Retry in Activity → Tasks.

cloudSourceKept.title: Files are in the cloud, but the download tasks could not be deleted
cloudSourceKept.body: {detail}. Delete the tasks manually in the downloader, or turn off automatic deletion in Settings → Cloud drives.

cloudRevoked.title: This server is disconnected from MovieClaw Cloud
cloudRevoked.body: {reason}. Official push notifications to phones have stopped. Reconnect in Settings → MovieClaw Cloud to resume.
cloudRevoked.reason: This server has been disconnected from the MovieClaw account

cloudVersion.title: Official push paused: update required
cloudVersion.body: {reason}. Push notifications will resume automatically after the update. There is no need to reconnect.
cloudVersion.reason: This version no longer supports MovieClaw official push notifications. Please update.

cloudUnreachable.title: Cannot connect to MovieClaw Cloud
cloudUnreachable.body: {reason}. {expired, select, yes {The token has expired and official push notifications are paused.} other {The token will expire soon, which will pause official push notifications.}} Check this server’s internet connection or configure a proxy for MovieClaw Cloud in Settings → Network.

channels.testSent: Sent to {count, plural, one {# account} other {# accounts}}
